tool_schemas.name: zotero_search_items
tool_schemas.description: Searches the mirrored Zotero library for items matching the free-text query across indexed fields (including fulltext when available) and returns a paged list of matching items sorted by the requested sort/order; pass the returned cursor to fetch the next page, and omit cursor to start from the first page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if library_id is not a zlib_* ULID, if limit is outside 1–200, or if item_type/sort/order are not one of the allowed values. Raises NOT_FOUND if the library_id does not exist or is not mirrored for your account, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you lack access to the library or your token is missing/invalid.

library_id.description: ULID of the mirrored Zotero library to search within.

query.description: Free-text query to search across indexed item fields (e.g., title, creators, abstract, fulltext when available).

item_type.description: Restrict results to a specific item type.

collection_id.description: Restrict results to items in a specific mirrored collection.

tag.description: Restrict results to items having a tag with this name.

has_fulltext.description: If true, only return items with fulltext indexed.

include_deleted.description: If true, include items marked deleted in the mirror.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: zotero_get_item_metadata
tool_schemas.description: Returns detailed metadata for the specified item_key within the mirrored library, optionally including child items, collections, and tags when the corresponding include_* flags are true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if library_id is not a zlib_* ULID or required parameters are missing. Raises NOT_FOUND if the library or item_key is not present in the mirror (including when the item has not been synced), and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the library.

library_id.description: ULID of the mirrored Zotero library.

item_key.description: Zotero item key (the Zotero API key for the item) to fetch metadata for.

include_children.description: If true, include basic information about child items (attachments/notes) in the response.

include_collections.description: If true, include collections this item belongs to.

include_tags.description: If true, include tags associated with the item.

tool_schemas.name: zotero_get_item_fulltext
tool_schemas.description: Returns the indexed fulltext for the specified item_key (typically an attachment) from the mirrored library. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if library_id is not a zlib_* ULID or required parameters are missing. Raises NOT_FOUND if the library or item is not present in the mirror or if no fulltext has been indexed for that item, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the library.

library_id.description: ULID of the mirrored Zotero library.

item_key.description: Zotero item key to fetch fulltext for (typically an attachment item).

tool_schemas.implementation:
def zotero_get_item_fulltext(library_id, item_key, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, hashlib
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0498000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0498000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _record_operation(lib_id, status, result_summary=None, error_code=None, error_message=None, request_params=None):
        ops = _load("operations.json")
        minute_ago = (datetime.datetime.utcnow() - datetime.timedelta(seconds=60)).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        recent = sum(1 for r in ops if r.get("library_id") == lib_id and isinstance(r.get("created_at"), str) and r["created_at"] >= minute_ago)
        if recent >= 60:
            status = "failed"
            error_code = "RATE_LIMITED"
            error_message = "Rate limit exceeded for this library"
            result_summary = None

        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        raw = f"{time.time_ns()}:{os.getpid()}:{os.urandom(16).hex()}".encode("utf-8")
        digest = hashlib.sha1(raw).digest()
        bits = int.from_bytes(digest[:17], "big")
        chars = []
        for _ in range(26):
            chars.append(alphabet[bits & 31])
            bits >>= 5
        op_id = "zop_" + "".join(reversed(chars))

        op = {
            "id": op_id,
            "library_id": lib_id,
            "op_type": "get_item_fulltext",
            "request_params_json": request_params if isinstance(request_params, dict) else {},
            "status": "succeeded" if status == "succeeded" else "failed" if status == "failed" else status,
            "result_summary_json": result_summary,
            "error_code": error_code,
            "error_message": error_message,
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now if status in ("succeeded", "failed", "cancelled") else None,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        }
        ops.append(op)
        _save("operations.json", ops)
        return op

    if not isinstance(library_id, str) or not re.match(r"^zlib_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$", library_id):
        _record_operation(library_id if isinstance(library_id, str) else "unknown", "failed",
                          error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR", error_message="library_id must be a zlib_* ULID",
                          request_params={"library_id": library_id, "item_key": item_key})
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "library_id must be a zlib_* ULID")
    if not isinstance(item_key, str) or item_key.strip() == "":
        _record_operation(library_id, "failed",
                          error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR", error_message="item_key is required",
                          request_params={"library_id": library_id, "item_key": item_key})
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "item_key is required")

    libs = _load("libraries.json")
    lib = next((l for l in libs if l.get("id") == library_id), None)
    if not lib:
        _record_operation(library_id, "failed",
                          error_code="NOT_FOUND", error_message="library not found",
                          request_params={"library_id": library_id, "item_key": item_key})
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "library not found")
    if lib.get("status") in ("revoked",):
        _record_operation(library_id, "failed",
                          error_code="UNAUTHORIZED", error_message="library access revoked",
                          request_params={"library_id": library_id, "item_key": item_key})
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "You do not have access to this library")

    items = _load("items.json")
    it = next((r for r in items if r.get("library_id") == library_id and r.get("zotero_key") == item_key), None)
    if not it or it.get("status") == "deleted":
        _record_operation(library_id, "failed",
                          error_code="NOT_FOUND", error_message="item not found",
                          request_params={"library_id": library_id, "item_key": item_key})
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "item not found")

    ft = it.get("fulltext_text")
    if not isinstance(ft, str) or ft.strip() == "":
        _record_operation(library_id, "failed",
                          error_code="NOT_FOUND", error_message="no fulltext indexed for this item",
                          request_params={"library_id": library_id, "item_key": item_key})
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "No fulltext indexed for this item")

    op = _record_operation(
        library_id,
        "succeeded",
        result_summary={"item_id": it.get("id"), "chars": len(ft)},
        request_params={"library_id": library_id, "item_key": item_key}
    )
    return {
        "operation_id": op.get("id"),
        "item_id": it.get("id"),
        "item_key": it.get("zotero_key"),
        "fulltext_text": ft,
        "fulltext_indexed_at": it.get("fulltext_indexed_at"),
        "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    }

tool_schemas.name: zotero_get_collections
tool_schemas.description: Lists collections in the mirrored Zotero library (optionally filtered to a parent_collection_id and optionally including deleted collections) and returns results in pages; use cursor for the next page and omit cursor to start from the first page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if library_id/parent_collection_id do not match their required patterns, if limit is outside 1–500, or if sort/order are not allowed values. Raises NOT_FOUND if the library does not exist or parent_collection_id is not found in that library, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the library.

library_id.description: ULID of the mirrored Zotero library.

include_deleted.description: If true, include collections marked deleted in the mirror.

parent_collection_id.description: If provided, only list collections under this parent collection.

limit.description: Maximum number of collections to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: zotero_get_collection_items
tool_schemas.description: Lists items in the specified Zotero collection (by collection_key) from the mirrored library and returns a paged result set sorted as requested; use cursor for subsequent pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if library_id is not a zlib_* ULID, if limit is outside 1–200, or if item_type/sort/order are not allowed values. Raises NOT_FOUND if the library is missing, the collection_key does not exist in that library, or the collection has not been synced into the mirror, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the library.

library_id.description: ULID of the mirrored Zotero library.

collection_key.description: Zotero collection key to list items for.

include_deleted.description: If true, include items marked deleted in the mirror.

item_type.description: Restrict returned items to a specific item type.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: zotero_get_item_children
tool_schemas.description: Lists child items for a given parent item_key (attachments/notes/annotations as available), optionally filtered by child_item_type and optionally including deleted children, returning results in pages via cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if library_id is not a zlib_* ULID, if limit is outside 1–200, or if child_item_type/sort/order are not allowed values. Raises NOT_FOUND if the library or parent item_key is not present in the mirror, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the library.

library_id.description: ULID of the mirrored Zotero library.

item_key.description: Zotero item key to fetch child items for.

child_item_type.description: Restrict returned children to a specific item type.

include_deleted.description: If true, include child items marked deleted in the mirror.

sort.description: Sort order for returned child items.

limit.description: Maximum number of child items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: zotero_get_tags
tool_schemas.description: Lists tags used in the mirrored library (optionally filtered by a substring query) and returns a paged set of tag records sorted as requested; pass cursor to continue pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if library_id is not a zlib_* ULID, if limit is outside 1–500, or if sort/order are not allowed values. Raises NOT_FOUND if the library does not exist or is not mirrored for your account, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the library.

library_id.description: ULID of the mirrored Zotero library.

query.description: Optional substring to filter tag names.

limit.description: Maximum number of tags to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: zotero_get_recent
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of items recently created or updated within the last days in the mirrored library, optionally filtered by item_type and optionally including deleted items; use cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if library_id is not a zlib_* ULID, if days is outside 1–3650, if limit is outside 1–200, or if item_type/sort/order are not allowed values. Raises NOT_FOUND if the library does not exist or is not mirrored for your account, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the library.

library_id.description: ULID of the mirrored Zotero library.

days.description: Lookback window in days for recently added/updated items.

item_type.description: Restrict returned items to a specific item type.

include_deleted.description: If true, include items marked deleted in the mirror.

sort.description: Sort order for recently added items.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: zotero_batch_update_tags
tool_schemas.description: Starts a background job that finds items in the mirrored library matching the provided query and applies the requested tag additions/removals, returning a job record you can audit for status and any per-item errors. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if library_id is not a zlib_* ULID, if required fields are missing, or if the tag update request is malformed (e.g., invalid tag names or empty update operations). Raises NOT_FOUND if the library does not exist or is not mirrored for your account, raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the library, and raises CONFLICT if another incompatible write job is already in progress for the same library or the library is not in a writable/synced state.

library_id.description: Library ULID to run the batch tag update against.

query.description: Search query used to select matching items to update.

add_tags.description: Tag names to add to each matched item.

remove_tags.description: Tag names to remove from each matched item.

item_type.description: Restrict matched items to a specific item type.

collection_id.description: Restrict matched items to those in a specific collection.

limit.description: Maximum number of matched items to update in this operation.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for iterating through large match sets.

dry_run.description: If true, do not apply changes; only report what would change.

tool_schemas.name: zotero_advanced_search
tool_schemas.description: Perform an advanced search with multiple criteria.

value.description: Value to compare against (omit or leave empty when operator is 'exists').

criteria.description: List of criteria to combine in the advanced search.

match.description: How to combine criteria: all must match or any may match.

item_type.description: Restrict results to a specific item type.

collection_id.description: Restrict results to items in a specific collection.

tag.description: Restrict results to items that have a specific tag name.

include_deleted.description: If true, include items marked deleted in the mirrored store.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction for the chosen sort field.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: zotero_get_annotations
tool_schemas.description: Lists annotation records from the mirrored Zotero store for the given library, optionally restricted to a single parent item, and returns results sorted as requested and paged with an opaque cursor/limit (use the returned cursor to fetch the next page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any ID fails its required format or limit/sort parameters are out of range, and UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the specified library. Raises NOT_FOUND if the library_id does not exist in the mirror or if item_id is provided but does not exist in that library.

library_id.description: Library ULID to retrieve annotations from.

item_id.description: If provided, return annotations for this specific parent item.

include_deleted.description: If true, include annotations marked deleted in the mirrored store.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction for the chosen sort field.

limit.description: Maximum number of annotations to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of annotations.

tool_schemas.name: zotero_get_notes
tool_schemas.description: Lists note records from the mirrored Zotero store for the given library, optionally restricted to notes attached to a specific parent item, and returns results sorted as requested and paged with an opaque cursor/limit (use the returned cursor to fetch the next page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any ID fails its required format or limit/sort parameters are out of range, and UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the specified library. Raises NOT_FOUND if the library_id does not exist in the mirror or if parent_item_id is provided but does not exist in that library.

library_id.description: Library ULID to retrieve notes from.

parent_item_id.description: If provided, return notes attached to the given parent item.

include_deleted.description: If true, include notes marked deleted in the mirrored store.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction for the chosen sort field.

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of notes.

tool_schemas.name: zotero_search_notes
tool_schemas.description: Performs a full-text search over note content and note metadata in the mirrored Zotero store within the specified library, optionally restricted to a single parent item, and returns matches sorted by relevance or the requested field and paged with an opaque cursor/limit. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is empty, any ID fails its required format, or limit/sort parameters are out of range, and UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the specified library. Raises NOT_FOUND if the library_id does not exist in the mirror or if parent_item_id is provided but does not exist in that library.

query.description: Full-text query to search across note content and metadata.

parent_item_id.description: If provided, restrict search to notes attached to the given parent item.

include_deleted.description: If true, include notes marked deleted in the mirrored store.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction for the chosen sort field.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching notes to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of matches.

tool_schemas.name: zotero_create_note
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new note attached to the specified parent item in the given library, returning the created note record and a write job that tracks sync/commit status and any error details. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if IDs are malformed or note_html is missing/empty, and UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have write access to the specified library. Raises NOT_FOUND if the library_id does not exist in the mirror or if the parent_item_id does not exist in that library.

library_id.description: Library ULID where the note will be created.

parent_item_id.description: Parent item ULID the note should be attached to.

title.description: Optional note title to store alongside note content.

note_html.description: HTML body of the note as stored in Zotero.

tool_schemas.name: zotero_get_library
tool_schemas.description: Returns the mirrored library record for the given library_id, including current sync cursor, last_sync_at, and lifecycle status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if library_id is not a zlib_* ULID. Raises NOT_FOUND if the library is not present or is revoked and not visible to the caller. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the library.

library_id.description: ULID of the mirrored Zotero library to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: zotero_list_libraries
tool_schemas.description: Lists mirrored Zotero libraries the caller can access, optionally filtered by lifecycle status, and returns a paged result set. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated.

status.description: If provided, only return libraries in this status.

limit.description: Maximum number of libraries to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: zotero_update_library
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a mirrored library, including driving allowed lifecycle transitions via the status field. Returns the updated library record. Rejects any status transition not allowed by the library lifecycle map. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if parameters are invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the library does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot administer the library.

library_id.description: ULID of the mirrored Zotero library to update.

display_name.description: Human-friendly display name for the library.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the library; must be a valid transition from the current status.

api_base_url.description: Base URL for the upstream Zotero API (for hosted Zotero this is typically https://api.zotero.org).

access_token.description: Upstream Zotero access token to store/rotate for this library; provided in plaintext and stored encrypted by the service.

tool_schemas.name: zotero_get_operation
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single write/sync operation by id within the specified library, including status, result summary, and error details. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the operation does not exist in the library. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the library.

library_id.description: ULID of the mirrored Zotero library.

operation_id.description: ULID of the operation to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: zotero_list_operations
tool_schemas.description: Lists operations for a library (e.g., create_note, batch_update_tags), optionally filtered by status and op_type, returning newest-first results in pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs are invalid. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the library.

library_id.description: ULID of the mirrored Zotero library.

status.description: If provided, only return operations in this status.

op_type.description: If provided, only return operations of this type.

created_after.description: If provided, only return operations created at or after this timestamp.

created_before.description: If provided, only return operations created before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of operations to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

metadata.name: Zotero MCP
metadata.description: This backend mirrors a user’s Zotero library into a queryable store so the MCP tools can search items/notes, list collections/tags, fetch item metadata/fulltext/children, and create notes. It also tracks sync state and write operations (e.g., creating notes, batch tag updates) as jobs with auditable
